commands.name: playback.toggle
commands.description: Play if paused, pause if playing.
commands.label: Play or pause

commands.name: playback.play
commands.description: Start or resume playback.
commands.label: Play

commands.name: playback.pause
commands.description: Pause playback.
commands.label: Pause

commands.name: playback.seek
commands.description: Seek to a position in seconds from the start.
commands.label: Seek

commands.name: playback.skip
commands.description: Move the position forward or back by a number of seconds.
commands.label: Skip

commands.name: playback.rate
commands.description: Set the playback speed from 0.25 to 4, or step it by a delta.
commands.label: Speed

commands.name: audio.volume
commands.description: Set the volume from 0 to 2 (above 1 boosts up to 200%), or step it by a delta.
commands.label: Volume

commands.name: audio.mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Mute

commands.name: view.fullscreen
commands.description: Enter or leave fullscreen; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Fullscreen

commands.name: media.open
commands.description: Ask the person to pick a video file and play it.
commands.label: Open file

commands.name: media.close
commands.description: Stop the current video and return to the start screen.
commands.label: Close video

commands.name: state.read
commands.description: Read the player state: media, tracks, clock (position, playing, rate, volume, muted) and playback.
commands.label: Player state

commands.name: caps.read
commands.description: Read what this browser can do: WebCodecs, File System Access and codec support.
commands.label: Capabilities

commands.name: subtitle.track
commands.description: Choose the subtitle track by list index (-1 turns subtitles off) or id, or step to the next one, Off included.

index.description: Position in subtitle.read tracks; -1 is Off

next.description: Step to the next track, wrapping through Off

commands.label: Subtitle track

commands.name: subtitle.delay
commands.description: Set the subtitle delay in seconds (positive shows subtitles later), or change it by a delta. It resets for each file.
commands.label: Subtitle delay

commands.name: subtitle.style
commands.description: Set caption size, text colour, background opacity and vertical position; the settings persist on this device.

position.description: Distance from the bottom of the picture, in percent

commands.label: Subtitle style

commands.name: subtitle.load-file
commands.description: Load an SRT, WebVTT, ASS, SSA or PGS (.sup) subtitle file for the current video. With no input it asks the person to pick a file; agents pass name and text (text formats only).

name.description: File name, used for the format and the track label

replaceId.description: Id of a loaded subtitle file track to replace in place (same id, still selected); an unknown id adds a new track

commands.label: Load subtitles…

commands.name: subtitle.secondary
commands.description: Show a second text subtitle track at the top of the picture, by list index (-1 turns it off) or id, or step to the next one, Off included.

index.description: Position in subtitle.read tracks; -1 is Off

next.description: Step to the next text track, wrapping through Off

commands.label: Second subtitle track

commands.name: subtitle.renderer
commands.description: Read or set how ASS/SSA subtitles draw: styled (fonts, colours and positions through libass) or plain text. With no input it reports the mode and the renderer in use.
commands.label: ASS renderer

commands.name: subtitle.read
commands.description: Read the subtitle tracks, the selected track, the delay, the caption style and the text on screen.
commands.label: Subtitle state

commands.name: subtitle.save
commands.description: Save the selected subtitle track as an SRT or WebVTT file, with the current delay applied. download false returns the text instead.
commands.label: Save subtitles

commands.name: frame.step
commands.description: Show the next (direction 1) or previous (direction -1) frame while paused; if playing, the first step pauses.
commands.label: Step one frame

commands.name: loop.set
commands.description: Set or clear the A-B loop. "cycle" sets A, then B, then clears, at the current position; "set" takes aS and bS; "a" and "b" set one point; "clear" removes the loop.

bS.description: Loop end in seconds (set, b); must be after A

commands.label: A-B loop

commands.name: loop.read
commands.description: Read the A-B loop: phase (off, a, ab), aS and bS in seconds, and what the engine is looping.
commands.label: Loop state

commands.name: chapter.next
commands.description: Seek to the start of the next chapter.
commands.label: Next chapter

commands.name: chapter.previous
commands.description: Seek to the start of the current chapter when more than 3 s into it, otherwise to the previous chapter.
commands.label: Previous chapter

commands.name: chapter.go
commands.description: Seek to the start of the chapter at a zero-based index.
commands.label: Go to chapter

commands.name: chapter.list
commands.description: List the chapters (title, startS, endS), the current chapter index and whether the chapters panel is open.
commands.label: Chapters

commands.name: chapter.panel
commands.description: Open or close the chapters panel; with no input it toggles.

open.description: true opens the panel, false closes it

commands.label: Chapters panel

commands.name: playback.jump-to
commands.description: Seek to a typed time such as "1:23:45", "83:20", "90" (seconds) or "45%"; with no time it opens the jump-to-time box.

time.description: h:mm:ss, m:ss, seconds, or a percentage like "45%"

commands.label: Jump to time

commands.name: audio.track
commands.description: Switch to the audio track at a zero-based index, or step through the tracks by delta; with no input it moves to the next track.

delta.description: Tracks to move; negative goes back

commands.label: Audio track

commands.name: audio.delay
commands.description: Offset the audio against the video from -10 to 10 seconds (positive plays audio later): set delayS, step by deltaS, or reset to 0.

deltaS.description: Change from the current delay in seconds

commands.label: Audio delay

commands.name: audio.read
commands.description: List the audio tracks (title, language, codec, channels), the selected index, the audio delay and whether the audio panel is open.
commands.label: Audio tracks

commands.name: audio.panel
commands.description: Open or close the audio panel (tracks and delay); with no input it toggles.

open.description: true opens the panel, false closes it

commands.label: Audio panel

commands.name: bookmark.add
commands.description: Add a bookmark at timeS (default: the current position) with an optional name; with an id, rename that bookmark instead.
commands.label: Add bookmark

commands.name: bookmark.list
commands.description: List this file's bookmarks (id, timeS, name) sorted by time, whether they are stored, how many files have stored bookmarks, and whether the bookmarks panel is open.
commands.label: Bookmarks

commands.name: bookmark.panel
commands.description: Open or close the bookmarks panel; with no input it toggles.

open.description: true opens the panel, false closes it

commands.label: Bookmarks panel

commands.name: bookmark.go
commands.description: Seek to a bookmark, chosen by id or by index.
commands.label: Go to bookmark

commands.name: bookmark.remove
commands.description: Delete a stored bookmark, chosen by id or by index. It cannot be undone.
commands.label: Remove bookmark

commands.name: bookmark.clear-all
commands.description: Delete the stored bookmarks of every file in this browser. It cannot be undone. Returns how many files had bookmarks.
commands.label: Clear all bookmarks

commands.name: view.snapshot
commands.description: Save the current video frame as a PNG at the size the video is drawn, and return its name and size (never the image). save false is the explicit export request: it saves nothing and returns the PNG as a data URL.

save.description: false exports the PNG as a data URL and saves nothing; default true returns only the name and size

commands.label: Snapshot

commands.name: view.aspect
commands.description: Set the display aspect ratio (auto, 16:9, 4:3, 2.35:1 or 1:1); with no input it moves to the next one.
commands.label: Aspect ratio

commands.name: view.crop
commands.description: Set the crop (none, pillarbox removes the side bars of 4:3 inside 16:9, letterbox removes the bars of 2.35:1 inside 16:9); with no input it moves to the next one.
commands.label: Crop

commands.name: view.zoom
commands.description: Zoom and pan the picture: set scale (1 to 8) and the view centre x, y (0 to 1 across the picture), step in or out, or reset to the whole picture.

x.description: Centre of the view, 0 left to 1 right

y.description: Centre of the view, 0 top to 1 bottom

commands.label: Zoom

commands.name: view.adjust
commands.description: Set brightness (-1 to 1, default 0), contrast (0 to 2, default 1), saturation (0 to 2, default 1) or gamma (0.2 to 5, default 1); reset true restores all four.
commands.label: Picture adjustments

commands.name: view.deinterlace
commands.description: Set deinterlacing: off, blend (mixes the two fields) or bob (rebuilds the picture from one field); with no input it moves to the next one.
commands.label: Deinterlace

commands.name: view.tonemap
commands.description: For HDR10 and HLG video: auto maps HDR to the screen (SDR, or HDR where the display and browser offer it); off clips at SDR white. With no input it toggles.
commands.label: HDR tone mapping

commands.name: view.read
commands.description: Read the aspect, crop, zoom, adjustments, deinterlacing and tone mapping chosen, the view the engine applies, which path maps HDR now (hdrPath: shader is Reel's tone curve, browser is the browser's own conversion, extended, off or none), the last snapshot, and the Picture-in-Picture state.
commands.label: Picture state

commands.name: view.pip
commands.description: Open or close Picture-in-Picture (a document window with the video and its controls where the browser offers one, else a video window); with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Picture-in-Picture

commands.name: queue.open-folder
commands.description: Queue a folder's videos in natural sort order and play the first. Standalone it asks the person to pick a folder. Hosted in NakliOS it reads the folder at `path` in Reel's NakliOS storage ("" is the top), starting at the video `start` when given; with no path it opens the NakliOS file list.

path.description: Hosted only: folder path in Reel's NakliOS storage, from hosted.list

start.description: Hosted only: path of the video to play first

commands.label: Open folder

commands.name: queue.play
commands.description: Play the queue item at an index (natural folder order, starting at 0).
commands.label: Play queue item

commands.name: queue.next
commands.description: Play the next queue item, following shuffle and repeat-all.
commands.label: Next in queue

commands.name: queue.previous
commands.description: Restart the current item if more than 3 seconds in, else play the previous queue item.
commands.label: Previous in queue

commands.name: queue.repeat
commands.description: Set repeat to off, all or one; with no input it cycles off, all, one.
commands.label: Repeat

commands.name: queue.shuffle
commands.description: Turn shuffle on or off; with no input it toggles. The current item stays current.
commands.label: Shuffle

commands.name: queue.reopen-folder
commands.description: Reopen the folder picked last time (Chromium only): ask for read permission again, queue it and play the first video.
commands.label: Reopen last folder

commands.name: queue.forget-folder
commands.description: Delete the remembered folder (the stored folder handle behind "Reopen last folder"). It cannot be undone; picking the folder again remembers it again.
commands.label: Forget folder

commands.name: queue.read
commands.description: Read the queue: items, current index, play order, repeat, shuffle, sibling subtitle names, whether the panel is open and the stored last folder.
commands.label: Queue

commands.name: queue.panel
commands.description: Open or close the queue panel; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Queue panel

commands.name: hosted.list
commands.description: Read the videos and subtitle files in Reel's NakliOS storage under `path` ("" or no path is the top): each with its path and kind, the folders that hold videos, the storage location, whether it streams by ranged reads, whether the list is open and the hosted path playing now. Standalone it reports available false.

path.description: Folder path in Reel's NakliOS storage

commands.label: NakliOS files

commands.name: hosted.open
commands.description: Play the video at `path` in Reel's NakliOS storage, queueing the videos of its folder with their subtitle files. A subtitle path loads that file for the video playing now.
commands.label: Open from NakliOS

commands.name: hosted.panel
commands.description: Open or close the list of videos in Reel's NakliOS storage; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: NakliOS file list

commands.name: library.open
commands.description: Open or close the library view of the opened folder; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Library

commands.name: library.read
commands.description: Read the library: each video with its duration, fingerprint, poster state (cached, placeholder or pending) and watch state (new, partial or watched, from the resume history), and what Reel stores (history entries, files with bookmarks, posters, remembered folder). Cards are described only while the library is open.
commands.label: Library contents

commands.name: library.stored-data
commands.description: Open or close the Stored data dialog, which lists what Reel keeps in this browser and deletes it; with no input it toggles.
commands.label: Stored data

commands.name: library.clear-history
commands.description: Delete the watch history: every resume position and the Continue watching list, in this browser and in the Crate when Crate watch history is on. It cannot be undone. Returns how many entries it deleted.
commands.label: Clear watch history

commands.name: library.clear-posters
commands.description: Delete every library poster Reel saved in this browser (OPFS reel-posters). They are made again when each video plays. Returns how many it deleted.
commands.label: Clear posters

commands.name: ai.transcribe
commands.description: Generate subtitles from the speech in the current video, in 30-second windows, and load them as an editable SRT track named "(generated)". Inside NakliOS the host speech model is the default; route "local" runs Whisper tiny on this device. The one-time local model download is a person-only act: from an agent it refuses unless the model is already kept. cancel stops a running job.

route.description: Defaults to auto (host inside NakliOS, else local)

language.description: Spoken language code such as "en" or "hi"; omitted lets Whisper detect it

fromS.description: Start of the range to transcribe; defaults to 0

toS.description: End of the range; defaults to the end of the video

export.description: true also returns the SRT text; by default only counts and ids come back

commands.label: Generate subtitles

commands.name: ai.translate
commands.description: Translate the selected subtitle track into a language with the NakliOS host chat model, keeping cue times, and load it as a new track named "(translated)". The subtitle text goes to that model, which may be an outside service (ai.read reports where it runs). Outside NakliOS there is no translation model and it refuses. cancel stops a running job.

language.description: Target language code or name, such as "fr" or "French"

trackIndex.description: Subtitle track position from subtitle.read; defaults to the selected track

export.description: true also returns the SRT text; by default only counts and ids come back

commands.label: Translate subtitles

commands.name: ai.read
commands.description: Read the local speech model state (absent, cached, loading, loaded), the route for transcription and translation (host, local or none), where translation runs (device, remote or unknown, with the model and provider), the running job and its progress, the last generated track and whether the AI panel is open.
commands.label: AI state

commands.name: ai.panel
commands.description: Open or close the AI panel (subtitles from speech and translation); with no input it toggles.

open.description: true opens the AI panel, false closes it

commands.label: AI panel

commands.name: help.show
commands.description: Open or close the keyboard help sheet; with no input it toggles. Returns whether the sheet is open and the shortcuts it lists.
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts

commands.name: door.read
commands.description: Read which WebMCP API was found and how many commands it registered as tools, whether Reel is hosted in NakliOS and how many commands it registered there, and whether the offline service worker is registered, with its scope and cache.
commands.label: Agent and offline status
